cell.rationale: pyramid faces off the prism family on the asymmetric pyramid of tests/test_optics_crystal_native.py (focusing.classify reaches it, roadmap 2026-09-27); a generic admissible point: first uniform draw of a fixed-seed generator that passes discovery's gates

branch_margins.basis: absolute, per named margin, the same key set; the margins are cosines and discriminants of the chain: float64 evaluation of the same closed-form refraction/reflection chain from bit-identical JSON inputs: a few ulp per interface (1e-12 leaves ~1e3 ulp of room), times 1/(2 sqrt(d)) for the smallest Snell discriminant d of the pose, the derivative of the refracted cosine sqrt(d) (kinematic_atol)

failed_gate.basis: the gate name exactly, its (non-positive) margin as branch_margins
